item.title: Cirque du Sunflower - Collector Colour — Koigu
item.description: The final collector colour of our floral summer series is here! The golden sunsets of summer are still here, but a little earlier & a little chillier, but full of promise of a busy September ahead!

item.title: Classic Car Show - Collector Colour — Koigu
item.description: A classic family outing - a classic car show! Every small town has one and you can often see the classic cars gathering at fall fairs & markets. October is the last hurrah for these pristine beauties that will soon be put to bed for the winter.

item.title: #MakeitKoigu Feature: Crochet Best Friend Blanket — Koigu
item.description: 2 best friends, 26 paint cans, 176 granny squares… One of our favourite #makeitkoigu projects this year!

item.title: Pattern Feature: The Elliot Shawl — Koigu
item.description: Divya and Swaran of Michigan Fine Yarns came to the Koigu farm to visit last week to get inspired and show off their new gorgeous shawl they are launching - The Elliot Shawl!

item.title: Candlelit Feast - Collector Colour — Koigu
item.description: CANDLELIT FEAST is inspired by the cozy richness of a dimly lit winter night spent with loved ones surrounded by warm food. Velvety reds, waxy golds and warm sages blend into this decadent limited edition colourway.

item.title: Holiday Market - Collector Colour — Koigu
item.description: Our favourite thing about this time of year is the sudden explosion of beautiful markets everywhere! item.title: Cloud Dancer - Collector Colour — Koigu
item.description: If you haven’t heard yet, the official Pantone Colour of 2026 is ‘Cloud Dancer’ an off-white, blank canvas to get creative with or neutral to add to let other colours shine.

item.title: Break Room - Collector Colour — Koigu
item.description: Inspired by the 1970s office break room - think clementine orange shag carpets, bright coloured appliances and dusty blue suits drinking coffee. A collector colour to inspire you to put your feet up with your caffeine drink of choice, and cast on a colourful new project.

item.title: Atmosphere - Collector Colour — Koigu
item.description: Spring is upon us and with it we can feel the shifting winds, the ground start to thaw and the crisp chill of winter start to give way to the warm mist of spring. This month’s collector colour, ATMOSPHERE, is inspired by the freshness of air, water and nature surrounding us.
